faqs.question: What does 🌀💨 mean from a stranger?
faqs.answer: From a stranger 🌀💨 usually reads as a public-coded reaction. The combo is the same on comment sections regardless of relationship.

faqs.question: Is 🌀💨 flirty?
faqs.answer: 🌀💨 is not flirty by default. The reaction register is broader than flirting; reach for flirt-coded combos when attraction is the point.

faqs.question: Can 🌀💨 be sarcastic?
faqs.answer: Yes — reaction-coded pairs often carry sarcasm when the partner emoji is an angry or unimpressed face. Watch the lead-up.

faqs.question: What does 🌀💨 mean at work?
faqs.answer: At work 🌀💨 is fine in tight teams. Across roles and seniority the reaction register can read as unprofessional; prefer sentences there.
